haiku-low.q1: They still get their same account. Matching is only on Google sub, email is looked at only when the sub is unlinked, and users.email is never overwritten from Google.
haiku-low.q2: The email must be verified, then the user confirms on the confirm page with the correct password (bcrypt) using a valid unexpired ticket, which links the identity and starts a session.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins. The 5th sets locked_until to now plus 15 min, resets the counter, drops the ticket; after the lock they must restart Google sign-in.
haiku-low.q4: Verified email with no match creates a new user (NULL password_hash, email_verified_at now) plus identity, then a session. Unverified email is refused, told to use email and password, nothing created.
haiku-low.q5: Both are refused with the 'sign-in expired or invalid, try again' page. The attempt expired after 10 min TTL, or GETDEL already removed it on first use, so nothing is written.
haiku-low.q6: start_session creates a sessions row and sets an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax sid cookie for 14 days, slid on use. Any old sid session is killed first, so the existing cookie is replaced.
haiku-low.q7: No password or email match is required. The callback checks the session user matches the attempt user_id. If the sub is linked to another user, it refuses with 'linked to another account'.
haiku-low.q8: They are stored in Redis under oidc:attempt:<state> with a 10 min TTL. The callback GETDELs the row atomically at first use; unused rows just expire.
haiku-low.q9: Redis oidc:pending:<id> holds user_id, google_sub, google_email and next. The browser holds only the id in an HttpOnly, Secure pending_link cookie. Success or lock deletes it, and it expires after 10 min.
haiku-low.q10: In the Postgres user_identities table. UNIQUE(provider, subject) enforces one user per Google account, and UNIQUE(user_id, provider) enforces one Google identity per user.
haiku-low.q11: The user lands on /login with 'Google sign-in failed, try again'. The exchange is not retried, because codes are single-use and the attempt row is already gone.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt stores a mode of login or link. Link attempts store user_id, and the callback checks the signed-in session's user matches it, otherwise it shows the same error page.

sonnet.q1: They still get their same account. Matching is only on sub (email is looked at only when the sub isn't linked), and users.email is never overwritten from Google. Identity row found, so start_session.
sonnet.q2: Callback creates a half-link (pending ticket in Redis, pending_link cookie) and shows the confirm page. The user must enter the existing account's correct password (POST /auth/google/confirm). Only then is the identity inserted, failed_logins reset, pending record deleted, cookie cleared, and start_session run.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password: failed_logins + 1 and the form is shown again. The 5th wrong sets locked_until = now + 15 min (counter reset) and drops the ticket (and clears cookie); user must restart Google sign-in after the lock. No link is created. If already locked, ticket dropped and 'Account temporarily locked'.
sonnet.q4: Verified email with no match on lowercased email: one transaction creates a users row (NULL password_hash, email_verified_at = now) plus the identity row, then a session starts. If email not verified: refused, told to use email+password, nothing created.
sonnet.q5: Either way the attempt record (oidc:attempt:<state>, 10 min TTL, GETDEL'd on first callback) is missing, so the user sees the 'sign-in expired or invalid, try again' page. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q6: start_session: kills any old sid session, inserts a new sessions row, sets the sid cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax) for 14 days slid forward on use, then redirects to next if a relative on-site path, otherwise /home.
sonnet.q7: Neither: no password prompt, and the Google email need not match. The callback checks the signed-in session's user equals the attempt's user_id. If the sub is linked to another user, it is refused ('this Google account is linked to another account'); if already linked to this user, 'already linked'; otherwise insert and show 'Google linked'.
sonnet.q8: In Redis under oidc:attempt:<state> (mode, user_id if link, nonce, code_verifier, next), TTL 10 min. The callback GETDELs it first thing; unused ones expire by TTL.
sonnet.q9: In Redis at oidc:pending:<id> holding user_id, google_sub, google_email, next, TTL 10 min. The browser refers to it via the pending_link cookie (HttpOnly, Secure) carrying only the id. Deleted on successful confirm, on lock (or already locked), on the 5th wrong password, or by TTL expiry.
sonnet.q10: In the Postgres user_identities table (user_id, provider='google', subject = sub, email_at_link, linked_at). UNIQUE(provider, subject) gives one user per Google account; UNIQUE(user_id, provider) gives one Google account per user.
sonnet.q11: The user is sent to /login with 'Google sign-in failed, try again' (includes Google 5xx/timeout). No retry, because codes are single-use and the attempt row is already gone.
sonnet.q12: By the mode (login/link) stored in the Redis attempt record. For link mode, the callback checks the signed-in session's user is the attempt's user_id (stored at start); if not, it shows the same expired/invalid error page.
